flags.question: How many businesses in 'San Mateo' have been reviewed in September of any year?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business {city: 'San Mateo'})<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
WHERE r.date STARTS WITH '2015-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2016-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2017-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2018-09'
RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT b) AS numberOfBusinesses
details: Cypher uses STARTS WITH but TypeQL has no like pattern

flags.question: List the names of users who have reviewed businesses in both 'Missoula' and 'San Mateo'.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:WROTE]->(r:Review)-[:REVIEWS]->(b:Business)
WHERE b.city IN ['Missoula', 'San Mateo']
WITH u, b.city AS city
ORDER BY u.name, city
WITH u.name AS userName, collect(DISTINCT city) AS cities
WHERE 'Missoula' IN cities AND 'San Mateo' IN cities
RETURN userName
details: Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: What are the names of the top 5 businesses located in Missoula?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business {city: 'Missoula'})
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
WITH b, AVG(r.stars) AS avgRating
ORDER BY avgRating DESC
LIMIT 5
RETURN b.name
details: Cypher uses OPTIONAL MATCH but TypeQL has no try{} or equivalent

flags.question: List the top 3 businesses that are categorized under both 'Library' and 'Beer'.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c1:Category {name: 'Library'}),
      (b)-[:IN_CATEGORY]->(c2:Category {name: 'Beer'})
WITH b, COUNT(*) AS categoryCount
WHERE categoryCount = 2
MATCH (b)<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
RETURN b.name, AVG(r.stars) AS avgRating
ORDER BY avgRating DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: Which businesses have reviews written in September of any year?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business)<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
WHERE r.date STARTS WITH '2015-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2016-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2017-09' OR r.date STARTS WITH '2018-09'
RETURN DISTINCT b.name
details: Cypher uses STARTS WITH but TypeQL has no like pattern

flags.question: List the names of businesses that have only 4-star reviews.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business)<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
WHERE r.stars = 4.0
WITH b, COUNT(r) AS reviewCount, COLLECT(r.stars) AS starRatings
WHERE ALL(star IN starRatings WHERE star = 4.0)
RETURN b.name AS businessName
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: Find businesses that have reviews both above and below 4 stars.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (b:Business)<-[:REVIEWS]-(r:Review)
WITH b, 
     COLLECT(CASE WHEN r.stars > 4 THEN 'above' ELSE 'below' END) AS star_ratings
WHERE 'above' IN star_ratings AND 'below' IN star_ratings
RETURN b.name AS businessName, b.address AS businessAddress, b.city AS businessCity, b.state AS businessState
details: Cypher uses CASE WHEN but TypeQL may lack equivalent branching
